text: The Patriots prepare to host the Pittsburgh Steelers for their 2026 home opener at Gillette Stadium on Sunday, September 20 at 1 PM ET, though the week's narrative is decidedly split between adversity and inspiration: A.J. Brown's placement on injured reserve following a Week 1 high ankle sprain will sideline the wide receiver for at least four games, forcing the offense to adapt without one of its key playmakers, though Mike Reiss examined how other receivers can step up in his absence during preparation for this divisional matchup. On a more uplifting note, Drake Maye and his wife Ann Michael donated Amazon classroom wish lists for more than 50 teachers and support specialists at Alfred Lima Sr. Elementary School in Providence, while the Kraft family and Patriots Foundation announced $275,000 in donations in the names of twenty-six Myra Kraft Community MVP Award winners, with Susie Shaw of Carlisle receiving the $25,000 grand prize for William's Be Yourself Challenge.
